D&D Helper API — Codebase Guide\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nA small PHP/Slim API that implements deterministic D&D 5e helper tools:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ndice statistics, ability checks, encounter difficulty, character rules,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ncombat turn tracking, user authentication, a compendium, campaign state,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nPHB helpers, and DM utilities.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Quick start\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```bash\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n# Install dependencies (already present in vendor/ after composer install)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ncomposer install --no-interaction\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n# Start the server on the port specified by the PORT environment variable\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`./run.sh` is the only entry point required by the evaluator. It:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n1. Removes the existing `game.db` so each run starts fresh.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n2. Runs `INIT_DB=1 php index.php` to create the SQLite schema and exit.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n3. Starts the PHP built-in server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1:$PORT`.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nVerify the server is responding:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```bash\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n# => {\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"ok\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":true}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nThe server must be stopped with `Ctrl-C` (or by sending `SIGTERM` to the\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`run.sh` process). The evaluator starts its own server instance, so this\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nscript is not intended to daemonize.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Entry point and module layout\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── index.php              # Slim app bootstrap, middleware, route wiring\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── run.sh                 # Foreground server launcher\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── composer.json          # slim/slim 4.15.2, slim/psr7 1.8.0\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n├── game.db                # SQLite file created at runtime\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n└── src/\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    ├── ResponseHelper.php # Global respondJson() helper\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    ├── GameDatabase.php   # All SQLite schema and CRUD operations\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    ├── GameEngine.php     # Stateless game-rule calculations\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n    └── Handlers/\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── CoreHandler.php      # health, dice, checks, encounters, initiative\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── CharacterHandler.php # ability modifier, proficiency, derived stats\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── CombatHandler.php    # combat sessions, conditions, turn advancement\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── AuthHandler.php      # register / login\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── StorageHandler.php   # storage status / reset\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── CompendiumHandler.php# monsters, items\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── CampaignHandler.php  # campaigns, characters, events, factions, NPCs, inventory, equipment, state\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        ├── PhbHandler.php       # spell slots, long rest, equipment load\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n        └── DmHandler.php        # encounter builder, loot, session recap\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n```\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`index.php` is intentionally thin. It loads the autoloader and explicit\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nsource files, creates a `GameDatabase`, initializes the schema, and registers\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\neach handler group with the Slim app. The `INIT_DB=1` CLI shortcut is used by\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`run.sh` to create the database file before the web server starts.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## State, persistence, and routing design\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n### Persistence\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nState is stored in a single SQLite file (`game.db`) accessed through\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`GameDatabase`. The schema has twelve tables:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `users` — username (PK), role, password hash\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `combat_sessions` — id (PK), round, turn_index, JSON order, JSON conditions\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `monsters` — slug (PK), name, CR, AC, HP, JSON tags\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `items` — slug (PK), name, type, rarity, cost in gp\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `campaigns` — id (PK), name, DM\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `characters` — id (PK), campaign_id, name, level, class\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `events` — id (PK), campaign_id, kind, summary\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `quests` — id (PK), campaign_id, title, status, JSON milestones, JSON completed\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `factions` — id (PK), campaign_id, name, stance\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `npcs` — id (PK), campaign_id, name, faction_id, disposition\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `inventory` — id (PK), campaign_id, item_slug, quantity, owner\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `equipment` — id (PK), campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nJSON columns (`order_json`, `conditions_json`, `tags_json`) are encoded and\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ndecoded inside `GameDatabase` so callers always work with plain arrays. The\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nencoding uses `JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE` for storage; response encoding is handled\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nseparately by `respondJson()`.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`GameDatabase::initializeSchema()` creates tables with `IF NOT EXISTS`, and\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`GameDatabase::reset()` drops them in reverse creation order and recreates them.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n### Routing\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nThe Slim app is configured with:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- `AppFactory::create()` (uses `slim/psr7`)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Body parsing middleware (so JSON request bodies become arrays)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Routing middleware\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Error middleware with all display flags disabled (`false, false, false`)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nEach handler class exposes a `register(App $app)` method that maps its routes.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nHandler classes are instantiated in `index.php` and receive the dependencies\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nthey need (`GameDatabase`, `GameEngine`, or both). Business logic is kept out\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nof `index.php` and out of the route closures by using class methods as first-class\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ncallables.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n### Response format\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n`respondJson()` writes JSON using `JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES`.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nThis preserves values like `10.0` and keeps URLs readable. The helper returns the\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nPSR-7 response after setting the status code and `Content-Type: application/json` header.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## API / domain groupings\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Group      | Routes                                                                 |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Core       | `GET /health`, `POST /v1/dice/stats`, `POST /v1/characters/derived-stats` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Combat     | `POST /v1/combat/sessions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions`, `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Auth       | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login`                        |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Storage    | `GET /v1/storage/status`, `POST /v1/storage/reset`                     |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Compendium | `POST /v1/compendium/monsters`, `GET /v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`, `POST /v1/compendium/items`, `GET /v1/compendium/items/{slug}` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Campaigns  | `POST /v1/campaigns`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/characters`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/events`, `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/state`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/quests`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/{quest_id}/progress`, `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/summary`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/factions`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs`, `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/characters/{character_id}/equipment`, `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/summary` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| Play       | `POST /v1/play/campaigns`, `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`, `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start`, `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| PHB        | `POST /v1/phb/spell-slots`, `POST /v1/phb/rests/long`, `POST /v1/phb/equipment-load` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n| DM Tools   | `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `POST /v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `POST /v1/dm/session-recap` |\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nPure game calculations (ability modifier, proficiency, XP difficulty, initiative\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nordering, derived stats, max HP) live in `GameEngine`. All database access for\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nhandlers lives in `GameDatabase`. This split makes the rules easy to test without\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\na database and keeps request handlers focused on validation and response shaping.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Conventions for extending and testing\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Keep handlers thin.** Handlers validate input, call `GameDatabase` or\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  `GameEngine`, shape the response, and return it. Avoid adding business rules\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  directly in handlers; put them in `GameEngine`.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Add new routes by adding a handler method and registering it.** If a new\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  domain grows large enough, create a new handler class in `src/Handlers/`,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  require it in `index.php`, instantiate it, and call `register($app)`.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Re-use `respondJson()` for every JSON response.** Do not change the JSON\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  flags unless the evaluator contract is updated, because the test suite may\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  assert exact response bodies including float formatting.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Database changes go through `GameDatabase`.** Add new tables to\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  `initializeSchema()`, add CRUD methods, and update `reset()` to drop them in\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  reverse order. Do not issue raw SQL in handlers.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Preserve the CLI `INIT_DB` behavior.** `index.php` must exit(0) after schema\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  creation when `INIT_DB` is set, so `run.sh` can initialize the database\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  before launching the server.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Test game logic without a server.** `GameEngine` has no I/O dependencies;\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  instantiate it directly and call the rule methods. For integration testing,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  start the server via `run.sh`, use the actual API, and then stop the server.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- **Do not change response bodies, status codes, validation rules, or persistence\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  semantics.** This is a cumulative checkpoint; any observable change may break the\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n  evaluator suite.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"}],\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"isError\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":false,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"timestamp\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":1785956240683},{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"role\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"assistant\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"type\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"thinking\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"thinking\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"The failure is in `play-read-status-nonmember`.
